heard: China's last emperor ended up as a quiet Beijing gardener. Most people assume a deposed monarch faces lifelong imprisonment. Puyi became emperor at the age of two in December 1908. The 1912 abdication established the Republic of China. After decades of war and a Soviet prison, he was released. He spent his final years as a gardener in a Beijing Botanical Garden. China's last emperor ended up as a quiet Beijing gardener.
